proof_body:
by
  intro E₁ E₂ F _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ f L u hf hL hinv
  have hs : HasStrictFDerivAt f L u := hf.hasStrictFDerivAt' hL one_ne_zero
  have he := hs.eventually_apply_eq_iff_implicitFunctionOfProdDomain hinv
  refine ⟨hs.implicitFunctionOfProdDomain hinv, he.self_of_nhds.mp rfl, he, ?_⟩
  have hd := (hs.hasStrictFDerivAt_implicitFunctionOfProdDomain hinv).hasFDerivAt
  convert hd using 1
target_source: ∀ (E₁ E₂ F : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E₁] [NormedSpace ℝ E₁] [CompleteSpace E₁] [NormedAddCommGroup E₂] [NormedSpace ℝ E₂] [CompleteSpace E₂] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F] (f : E₁ × E₂ → F) (L : E₁ × E₂ →L[ℝ] F) (u : E₁ × E₂), ContDiffAt ℝ 1 f u → HasFDerivAt f L u → (L.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ E₁ E₂)).IsInvertible → ∃ φ : E₁ → E₂, φ u.1 = u.2 ∧ (∀ᶠ v in nhds u, f v = f u ↔ φ v.1 = v.2) ∧ HasFDerivAt φ (-((L.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ E₁ E₂)).inverse.comp (L.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ E₁ E₂)))) u.1
